answer: The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in zephyr, expire in lagoon, and timber lists each expiry. An adversary running 83 aliases thus needs 167 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4375 identities would post 2311 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
